mechanism: Scopolamine's anticholinergic effects may impair gastric motility and delay empagliflozin absorption; additionally, both drugs can cause volume depletion through different mechanisms (SGLT2 inhibitor glycosuria vs anticholinergic effects on fluid secretion).
action: Monitor for signs of dehydration, osmotic polyuria, and urinary tract infections; ensure adequate hydration and consider dose adjustment if volume depletion occurs; counsel patient on fluid intake.
